# QUIVANTA name and availability evidence

**Selected name:** QUIVANTA  
**Meaning:** quote + vantage, a clear view across global market signals  
**Ticker:** `QVNT` (presentation symbol for the testnet project)  
**Domain:** `quivanta.xyz`  
**X username:** `@quivanta`  
**Pronunciation:** `ki-VAN-ta`

QUIVANTA is an independent project on Robinhood Chain Testnet. The name does not claim affiliation with Robinhood, a token listing, or financial performance.

## Live read-only checks

Checks were repeated on **27 September 2026 at 07:04 UTC / 15:04 Asia/Shanghai**. Results are point-in-time observations, not registrations or legal clearance.

| Item | Method | Observed result | Conclusion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quivanta.xyz` | [CentralNic .xyz RDAP](https://rdap.centralnic.com/xyz/domain/quivanta.xyz) | HTTP 404; no domain object | No registration record was returned at check time. |
| `quivanta.fun` | [Radix .fun RDAP](https://rdap.radix.host/rdap/domain/quivanta.fun) | HTTP 404; description says domain is available for registration | No registration record was returned at check time. |
| `quivanta.top` | [ZDNS .top RDAP](https://rdap.zdnsgtld.com/top/domain/quivanta.top) | HTTP 404; no domain object | No registration record was returned at check time. |
| `@quivanta` | [X username availability endpoint](https://api.twitter.com/i/users/username_available.json?username=quivanta) | HTTP 200; `valid: true`; `reason: available` | X reported the username available at check time. |
| `@quivanta` public profile | [X profile URL](https://x.com/quivanta) | HTTP 404; no public profile page | No public profile was found; this is not a registration guarantee. |

The X account and domains have not been created or purchased by this workflow. Availability can change immediately, and the RDAP/X checks do not replace registration or a trademark search. Secure both identifiers together before publishing a launch.

## Alternatives checked

`Tradoryn` (`TRYN`, `tradoryn.xyz`, `@tradoryn`) and `Arcavyn` (`ARCV`, `arcavyn.xyz`, `@arcavyn`) also returned available X and RDAP results in the same 07:01 UTC check. QUIVANTA was selected because its quote + vantage meaning is clearer for a market terminal. Raw prior research files remain under `research/naming/` as evidence and are not active brand material.

## Technical identity boundary

The display brand and ticker are presentation identifiers. Robinhood Chain Testnet (chain ID `46630`), contract addresses, RPC URLs, ABI data, transaction receipts and historical deployment records remain unchanged. The existing dUSD contract's immutable on-chain name is `LATQOR Demo USD`; this rebrand does not claim that deployed token was renamed.
